# G12 Board usable for any project: what is left?

Your ask (A1, 2026-10-18 13:36): "37 steps and 37 steps done. but G12 is still in progress. so whats left?"

## The answer

**Nothing is left: G12 is done, only its mark was never changed.** A goal's mark ([ ] open, [~] in progress, [x] done)
is set by hand; the board counts the steps but does not tick a goal by itself, and G12 has no "Done when:" line that
would say when to tick it.

- **All 37 steps are done**, among them B126, the umbrella "Use the worker board for any game project".
- **The plan for it is finished.** The board's `ANY-PROJECT-PLAN.md` (B189, your yes B190) has eight parts; all
  eight are done. The last, the proof (B216, 2026-10-14), ran a made-up empty project from the README alone, in a
  fresh folder, without the mods; what it needed was fixed. The two leftovers it named, a trial on a real Mac (B215)
